description: Per-field options for a match full-text clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed match map (the map key is the column name).

query.description: Required. The text (or scalar value on a non-text column) to match. A string, number, or boolean depending on the target column type.

operator.description: Optional. Boolean logic used to combine the analyzed query terms: or (default) or and.

minimum_should_match.description: Optional. Minimum number of terms a document must match. An integer or a percentage / formula string.

analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize the query text. Defaults to the field's search analyzer.

fuzziness.description: Optional. Allowed edit distance: an integer or AUTO.

fuzzy_rewrite.description: Optional. How the fuzzy query is rewritten internally.

fuzzy_transpositions.description: Optional. Whether to count transpositions (ab → ba) as a single edit. Default true.

prefix_length.description: Optional. Number of leading characters left unchanged when fuzzy matching.

max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms the fuzzy expansion will generate.

cutoff_frequency.description: Optional. Term-frequency threshold above which terms are treated as low-importance.

auto_generate_synonyms_phrase_query.description: Optional. Whether to auto-generate phrase queries for multi-term synonyms. Default true.

lenient.description: Optional. When true, format-based errors (e.g. a text value against a numeric field) are ignored.

zero_terms_query.description: Optional. Behavior when the analyzer removes all tokens: none (default) or all.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.
